text: aluminum oblong foil pans. Use these at our annual family seafood boil.  They work perfectly to scoop in the boil stuff and throw on a table.  For us, they are the perfect size to put on a table of 6. We buy them year after year.

product_metadata.title: XIAFEI 9x13" Aluminum Foil Pans, Half Size Deep Foil Pans, Friendly Recyclable Aluminum, Portable Food Storage Containers, Great for Cooking, Heating, Storing, Prepping Food (30 Pack)
features: EXTRA THICK, DURABLE SQUARE PANS: Whether you’re running a catering business, cooking dinner for the family, barbequing or hosting a party, cook your food to perfection in these disposable pans. The walls are 2.56 inches high to prevent spillage will be baking or be transporting food.

DURABLE & FUNCTIONAL—Well-made aluminum pans which means they’re not flimsy. Designed to facilitate air flow, make it ideal for even heat distribution which reduces the chance of burned baked goods and helps in creating a beautiful smooth crust. Excellent in the kitchen, picnic, camping, BBQ events and other indoor and outdoor activities. Browns beautifully!

WIDE RIM—These foil pans have wide rims for easy carrying and a strong grip when placed over a chafer stand. Use these strong aluminum pans to serve food at your next party or event. They are sturdy enough to contain and transport large amounts of food to accommodate many guests. They’re perfect for birthday parties, anniversary dinners, Thanksgiving, Christmas, or any other holiday or get together that involves plenty of eating!

ECONOMICAL & RECYCLABLE—These aluminum foil pans that are easy to dispose and reuse. If you want to save few pennies then you can wipe them clean several times before replacing them. It has a decent size which will work for any freezer meals, oven cooking, marinating, sticky casseroles and more. These aluminum foil pans are a convenient way to transport and serve meals anywhere, anytime.

STOCK AND STACK— These pans stack neatly when stored in bulk! Always have a few on hand for your casseroles, vegetables, breads, and other dishes for your yard party or buffet. Reinforced with ribbed walls, these Steam Pans are strong enough for reheating, storage, and freezing. Simply discard or recycle them when the party's over.
